parameters.query:
SELECT
    raw_id,

    content_key,
    platform,
    shop_id,
    shop_name,
    content_id,

    product_id,
    product_name,
    sku_id,
    sku_name,

    product_rating,
    service_rating,
    logistics_rating,
    rating_scale_max,
    rating_label,

    content_text,
    content_time,
    collect_time,

    data_source,
    processing_status,

    content_type,
    root_review_id,
    parent_content_id,

    author_role,
    author_id,

    retry_count,
    last_error_stage,
    last_error_message,
    processed_at,
    pipeline_run_id,

    source_staging_id,
    source_review_id

FROM voc.raw_reviews
WHERE processing_status = 'NEW'
ORDER BY content_time ASC, raw_id ASC;

UPDATE voc.raw_reviews
SET
    processing_status = 'PROCESSED',
    processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    pipeline_run_id = $2,
    last_error_stage = NULL,
    last_error_message = NULL
WHERE content_key = $1
  AND processing_status = 'NEW'
RETURNING
    raw_id,
    content_key,
    processing_status,
    processed_at,
    pipeline_run_id;

SELECT
    raw_id,
    content_key,
    processing_status,
    processed_at,
    pipeline_run_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE processing_status = 'NEW'
    ) OVER () AS total_new,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE processing_status = 'PROCESSED'
    ) OVER () AS total_processed
FROM voc.raw_reviews
ORDER BY raw_id;

    retry_count = COALESCE(retry_count, 0) + 1,
    last_error_stage = $2,
    last_error_message = $3,
    pipeline_run_id = $4
WHERE raw_id = $1
  AND processing_status = 'NEW'
RETURNING
    raw_id,
    content_key,
    processing_status,
    retry_count,
    last_error_stage,
    last_error_message,
    pipeline_run_id;

nodes.name: Mark Raw Review Pre-Analysis Error v1.0

parameters.query:
WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS candidate
),
current_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        ar.analysis_id,
        ar.content_key,
        ar.analysis_run_id,
        ar.rules_version,
        ar.prompt_version,
        ar.model_name,
        ar.analysis_scope,
        ar.analysis_status,
        ar.final_risk_level,
        ar.need_ai,
        ar.ai_called,
        ar.decision_source,
        ar.is_current,
        ar.analyzed_at
    FROM voc.analysis_results ar
    CROSS JOIN input_data i
    WHERE ar.content_key = i.candidate->>'content_key'
      AND ar.is_current = TRUE
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    i.candidate,

    ca.analysis_id::text AS existing_analysis_id,
    ca.analysis_status AS existing_analysis_status,
    ca.rules_version AS existing_rules_version,
    ca.prompt_version AS existing_prompt_version,
    ca.model_name AS existing_model_name,
    ca.analysis_scope AS existing_analysis_scope,
    ca.final_risk_level AS existing_final_risk_level,
    ca.need_ai AS existing_need_ai,
    ca.ai_called AS existing_ai_called,
    ca.decision_source AS existing_decision_source,
    ca.analysis_run_id AS existing_analysis_run_id,
    ca.analyzed_at AS existing_analyzed_at

FROM input_data i
LEFT JOIN current_analysis ca ON TRUE;

parameters.jsCode:
const row = $json;
const candidate = row.candidate ?? {};

return {
  json: {
    ...candidate,

    existing_analysis_id:
      row.existing_analysis_id ?? null,

    existing_analysis_status:
      row.existing_analysis_status ?? null,

    existing_rules_version:
      row.existing_rules_version ?? null,

    existing_prompt_version:
      row.existing_prompt_version ?? null,

    existing_model_name:
      row.existing_model_name ?? null,

    existing_analysis_scope:
      row.existing_analysis_scope ?? null,

    existing_final_risk_level:
      row.existing_final_risk_level ?? null,

    existing_need_ai:
      row.existing_need_ai ?? null,

    existing_ai_called:
      row.existing_ai_called ?? null,

    existing_decision_source:
      row.existing_decision_source ?? null,

    existing_analysis_run_id:
      row.existing_analysis_run_id ?? null,

    existing_analyzed_at:
      row.existing_analyzed_at ?? null
  }
};
